day_summary: ATH CLOSE ESSENTIALLY RECLAIMED + US SESSION DELIVERS THIRD DEMAND CONFIRMATION. SK Hynix closed June 25 KST at ₩2,917,000 (+₩292,000, +11.1% from ₩2,625,000 June 24 close). Intraday high ₩2,987,000; low ₩2,749,000. The June 22 ATH close was ₩2,919,000 — SK Hynix is ₩2,000 below full ATH reclaim. KOSPI +5.42% to 8,930.30; Nikkei 225 +4.61% to 72,366.34. US session (post-KST close): PCE printed in-line (core 3.4%, 1 bp above 3.3% consensus) — the 'hold full position' scenario from the morning brief. The defining US-session development: Apple announced price increases on iPhone, iPad, and Mac citing higher memory costs; Microsoft raised Xbox prices on the same rationale. AAPL fell ~6.5%, MSFT fell 5.1%. MU closed $1,165.94 (+~17%). This is a THIRD independent demand confirmation for SK Hynix in 24 hours: OEMs are raising consumer hardware prices rather than canceling memory orders. The HBM capacity slowdown narrative (June 23 Korean media) is empirically rebutted by three consecutive demand confirmations. Framework stop ₩2,540,000 never triggered. June 26 KST opens with the US session's AAPL/MSFT memory price-pass-through as an additional structural tailwind. Sell-side PT revision cascade to ₩2,900,000–₩3,200,000 expected within 24–48 hours. ADR SEC clearance imminent.
